summary: Hiker with broken ankle east of Horsetooth Reservoir; LCSAR paged, stood down en route
location: 105 S. CR 23, east side of Horsetooth Reservoir (Sunrise Beach staging area)
notes: Radio traffic indicated a hiking subject with a broken ankle; Poudre Fire Authority requested LCSAR assist but LCSAR was stood down while en route; final outcome with PFA unknown. Source: Larimer County Search and Rescue, Inc. Facebook page.
